newsitem.title: ITALY: Trial of alleged Mafia child-killers opens.
newsitem.headline: Trial of alleged Mafia child-killers opens.

text.p: The trial of 43 alleged Mafia members accused of involvement in the kidnap and gruesome killing of a 13-year-old boy began on Tuesday, court sources said.
They said four of the defendants, including arrested Mafia boss Giovanni Brusca and his brother Vincenzo, were charged with the 1995 murder of Giuseppe di Matteo.
In chilling testimony, a former Mafia member now turned informer has alleged Brusca strangled di Matteo and dissolved the corpse in a bath of acid to destroy evidence.
Other defendants standing trial in the fortified courtroom of Palermo's Ucciardone prison were suspected of involvement in the 1993 kidnapping.
The Mafia wanted to use the abduction to force the child's father Santo, an ex-mafioso who went over to the state, to retract evidence about the murder of top anti-Mafia judge Giovanni Falcone.
Brusca, who was arrested last year after a police raid on his Sicilian villa, has admitted setting off the bomb which blew up Falcone and his wife in 1992.
